title: IVG Original Salts Riberry Lemonade 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Riberry Lemonade 10ml E-Liquid offers a sophisticated, beverage-inspired vaping experience that blends classic fruit sweetness with refreshing citrus. This profile features the rich, jammy depth of Blackcurrant Cordial, which provides a dark and fruity foundation. This is beautifully contrasted by the bright, zesty bite of fresh Lemonade, creating a well-rounded and deeply satisfying flavour that is perfect for all-day vaping. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the balanced notes of Riberry Lemonade, vapers can explore other stellar options like the vibrant Blue Blaze or the complex Forest Berries Ice. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
